fields.summary_ko.0: SK hynix Inc. (SKHY) declined 23.1% over past three months but expected to benefit from expanding AI adoption and data center infrastructure expansion driving high-performance memory chip demand.
fields.summary_ko.1: Recent quarter EPS of $3.84 fell short of Zacks estimate of $5.96 but revenue exceeded estimate by 11.2%; cloud service providers expected to increase capex 60% plus in 2027 and AI data centers projected to grow approximately 40% CAGR through 2030.
fields.summary_ko.2: SK hynix has long-term supply agreements (LTA) with 14 major customers, with 50% plus of total production capacity secured by contracts in 2027–2028, strengthening revenue visibility.
